summary: Backend-only verification of Harry Kane / Haaland / Mbappe / Messi / Ronaldo goalscorer fix. RESULT: Core fix is WORKING — all 5 elite strikers now appear with all 3 markets (Anytime Goal Scorer, First Goal Scorer, To Score or Assist). 14/15 new tests pass (93%). 92 Soccer picks returned (>=80 required). Vinicius Jr, Lamine Yamal, Jamal Musiala all present (no regression). Rollover and bet-killer endpoints alive (no 500). rca_of_issue: 1) ROOT CAUSE of the missing-Kane bug from the request — VERIFIED FIXED. Top-3 event cap and lack of elite-team priority sorting in _fetch_player_props_for_sport was filtering out England/France/Norway World Cup matches. After the fix (cap raised to 14, _event_priority puts anchor teams first, 168h lookahead), Kane/Mbappe/Haaland/Messi/Ronaldo all appear with full 3-market trios. Synthesis bidirectionality also working — Haaland's Senegal match only exposed Anytime Goal Scorer from The Odds API; the new FGS+SoA synthesis successfully derived the missing two markets (visible in feed: Erling Braut Haaland First Goal Scorer + To Score or Assist, both at lock 68.6). 2) NEW MINOR FINDING — /api/stats/summary uses a stricter elite definition (lock_score>=95) than the rest of the system (elite_player flag). Report says '12 elite' while feed has 58 elite_player picks. Easy fix: change MongoDB filter on server.py:1189 from {'$gte':['$lock_score',95]} to {'$eq':['$elite_player', True]} and line 1200 similarly. No retest required from testing agent — main agent can verify in 1 line.
